changelog: Complete UI redesign. The interface is rebuilt on Direct2D with a single minimal design system: one window with an icon rail, so Settings, Preferences, Keybinds, Swaps, Sessions and the AHK manager open in place instead of as separate popups. The in-game overlay is roughly half its old size, its text scales with each widget, and Box opacity now dims the panel behind a widget while the text on it stays fully readable. Your accent colour is used throughout. Existing settings, keybinds, swap profiles and sessions carry over unchanged.
